newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares mixed, Lisnave, BCP hit highs.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares mixed, Lisnave, BCP hit highs.

text.p: 1655 GMT - Portuguese shares closed mixed after a quiet session with turnover in the cash market just seven billion escudos. Ship repairer Lisnave, Banco Comercial Portugues and mobile phone operator Telecel hit highs, while Portugal Telecom and Banco Pinto e Sotto Mayor fell. Futures on the PSI-20 index of 20 leading shares rose. Operators said they expected to see selective trade on Monday and expected PT to remain under selling pressure. "PT does not seem to have hit the bottom after being the main motor of the market's rise last week," said one operator.
